messages:
sam: Quick sync — post-launch iteration plan for the smallwave release. Key items: P1 crash on onboarding, embedding quality regression for long docs, and a few UX polish asks. I want to finalize a 2-week patch scope today. Ideas on what we must include vs what can wait?
nicole: I'd lock the P1 crash and the embedding regression. Both are causing measurable user drops (see cohort A). UX polish can be prioritized after the patch unless it's <2 dev days.
jordan: Agree. For embedding regression, I can run a quick bisect on the model rollout and the pre/post quantization configs. If it's model-related we may need a rollback fallback policy.
lee: For the P1 crash, stack trace points to streaming buffer overflow when seq_len spikes. I can push a fix + test in a hotfix branch. Estimate ~1 day to patch and rollout canary.
emily: Customers on SLAs flagged the crash — we should treat that as must-ship. Also request we communicate the patch ETA to the handful of affected customers. I'll draft the customer note.
qa-bot: Test run scheduled: nightly-regression/smallwave-17005. Failing tests: 3 (embed-consistency, onboarding-e2e, stream-reconnect).
sam: Proposed scope for 2-week patch: (MUST) crash fix + canary rollout, embedding regression root cause & rollback plan, customer comms. (SHOULD) one small UX polish (reduce onboarding copy), (COULD) backlog cleanup for routing policies. Anyone object?
nicole: No objections. Suggest we also include a temporary rate-limit guard on streaming to reduce crash exposure while patch is validated. Low effort.
jordan: I'll start with the embed bisect today and post findings to this thread. If it's quantization, we may need to re-serve a float-variant for the flagged model — that will take longer but is acceptable as a follow-on step.
lee: Hotfix PR incoming in ~3 hours. Will attach rollout playbook in PR description (canary -> 50% -> 100% with telemetry checks).
emily: I'll create a small JIRA board: SW-PATCH-17005 and add owners + acceptance criteria. Acceptance: crash reproducer fixed, embed regression error < baseline on regression test, customer note drafted.
qa-bot: Assigned tests to @qa-team. Will run canary smoke every 30m during rollout once PR is merged.
sam: OK — landing plan: 1) lee pushes PR and starts canary; 2) jordan confirms embed signal & rollback plan; 3) nicole sets temporary streaming rate guard; 4) emily sends customer comms. Checkpoint tomorrow 11:00 for status.
emily: I'll post the calendar invite + customer note draft after this. :+1:
jordan: Update: found a downstream tokenizer truncation causing embed shift. Repro script attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/example/abcdef — will prepare a patch to normalize tokenization and add regression tests.
sam: Nice catch. That moves embedding fix into must-have. Adjusting owners accordingly. Thanks everyone.
